# ========== 预期解析结果 ==========
# 进度检测正则:
# - r'(?:(?:Progress|Done)[:\s]+)?(\d+)%'
# 提取: progress_pct = match.group(1)

# - "Reading measurement data" -> 5%
# - "Building forward lookup" -> 5-30%
